svg.title: How Berry Brain helps an agent resume work
svg.desc: A connected agent recalls allowed task state and tested lessons, checks current facts, and continues work. An optional provider-configured Jev check keeps, drops, or retains uncertain lessons for this response. When unavailable, normal recall continues. Saved evidence can support a candidate lesson; two helpful reports from new tasks with distinct evidence make it available to normal recall. Harmful feedback retires it.

g.text: Pick up where your agent left off
One private memory store. Shared context across your AI clients.
OPTIONAL · Jev checks which lessons fit
Local or server. Your provider and model. The same selection rules.
Off or unavailable? Normal recall continues. No stored lesson is deleted.
Turn checked results into reusable lessons
Agents save results explicitly. Memory does not train the model or grant permission.
